record.name: Guardian Meditation Crystals
record.narrative: These crystals pulse with a gentle, protective energy that enhances a Guardian's connection to defensive Force techniques. They feel warm and comforting to the touch, humming with a steady, reassuring tone rather than an aggressive buzz.
record.flavor_text: 'The strongest shield is a calm heart.' - Jedi Temple Proverb

mechanics.description: Increases the Save DC of your protective Force powers by 1.

connections.narrative: These crystals are commonly used by Jedi Guardians to focus their protective abilities.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: These crystals should feel warm and comforting to the touch, pulsing with steady, protective energy. They should hum with a reassuring tone that calms the mind and focuses the spirit.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: The save DC bonus makes these crystals a valuable asset for any Guardian who relies on control or defensive Force powers to protect their allies.
narrative_hooks: The crystals were a gift from a Jedi Master known for their legendary protective abilities
The crystals seem to resonate more strongly when used to defend an innocent
A dark side user might try to corrupt the crystals to twist their protective energy into a controlling one

image_generation.base_prompt: A set of three polished, translucent meditation crystals in soft blue and white tones, pulsing with a gentle, protective energy. The crystals are arranged in a triangular, protective pattern on a dark surface.
